answers.core: This would be a standard part of the script editor for replacing variable name script wide.
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around by NOT using assigned variable names to text or function names within the same script such as
var string = "This has the word example in it" or a function func _execute_example() but it is very useful in large script file.
or giving every variable name and underscore(_) before their names which not everyone does.

title: Smart Renaming of Variable names scriptwide within Replace(CTRL+R)
